subject: Fiscal Year 2026 Preliminary Budget Proposal
overview: The committee reviewed a preliminary FY26 budget proposal requesting a $4.5 million increase to address deferred maintenance, technology infrastructure, and software needs. No formal action was taken as the proposal serves as the initial funding request for the municipal administration.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2026 Budget Overview
items.summary: Budget Analyst Gerry McCue presented a draft proposal featuring a 5.5% increase to fund maintenance right-sizing, new technology positions, and mandated special education transportation costs. The proposal avoids general staffing cuts but holds most new personnel requests until high school schedule changes and federal grant statuses are finalized.

items.title: Committee Discussion and Funding Strategy
items.summary: The committee discussed strategies to close the 2.8% gap between the district's request and preliminary city projections, including the use of revolving funds and Question 8 override balances. Members noted the uncertainty caused by five expiring collective bargaining agreements and characterized the meeting as a preliminary framing of district needs before final reconciliation.
